display.title: Twelve Data Forex API
display.summary: Query realtime and historical Forex market data, currency conversion, reference data, and technical indicators; callers connect directly with their own Twelve Data credential.

documentation.stabilityNote: An independently curated Forex REST and realtime-quote contract based on current Twelve Data official material. Hub forwards a request only after the caller explicitly executes it and returns the result without caching or persisting caller credentials or responses.

pricing.summary: Twelve Data offers free and paid accounts; available Endpoints, data coverage, and request allowance depend on the caller's current plan.

credentials.description: Twelve Data API key supplied through a query parameter and used only in the caller session for direct requests.
